requirements.text: Implement real-time transaction notifications that include details such as amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
Provide automated monthly spending breakdowns by category and allow users to set personalized spending budgets with alerts for exceeding limits.
Incorporate biometric authentication methods, specifically fingerprint and facial recognition, for secure app access.
Enable instant card controls for users to freeze and unfreeze their cards within the app.
Ensure the app meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards for accessibility, including voice commands and screen reader compatibility.
Maintain seamless integration with the existing core banking system via the current API layer without major changes to the mainframe.
Ensure all features comply with PSD2 regulations, particularly around Strong Customer Authentication for payments and sensitive account access.
Ensure all customer data is stored and processed within the European Economic Area to comply with GDPR.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the current app for at least six months during the transition period.
